keyFeatures.title: Detects at the hot spot
keyFeatures.description: A pressurised red detection tube runs past every DIN rail; heat bursts it exactly where the fault is.

keyFeatures.title: No power, no electronics
keyFeatures.description: The pressure drop opens the 2 kg cylinder's valve on its own - it works with the panel dead.

keyFeatures.title: Floods the enclosure
keyFeatures.description: The agent discharges inside the closed cabinet, right at the source, before a fault becomes a fire.
